-->
<template>
	<AsamTabs
		:model-value="editableTabsValue"
		type="card"
		editable
		class="demo-tabs"
		@update:model-value="
			(value) => {
				if (typeof value === 'string') editableTabsValue = value;
			}
		"
		@edit="handleTabsEdit"
	>
		<AsamTabPane
			v-for="item in editableTabs"
			:key="item.name"
			:label="item.title"
			:name="item.name"
		>
			{{ item.content }}
		</AsamTabPane>
	</AsamTabs>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTabsCapDynamicTabsDemo' });
import { AsamTabs, AsamTabPane } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { ref } from 'vue';
let tabIndex = 2;
const editableTabsValue = ref('2');
const editableTabs = ref([
	{
		title: '标签页一',
		name: '1',
		content: 'Tab 1 content'
	},
	{
		title: '标签页二',
		name: '2',
		content: '标签页二的内容'
	}
]);
const handleTabsEdit = (targetName, action) => {
	if (action === 'add') {
		const newTabName = `${++tabIndex}`;
		editableTabs.value.push({
			title: '新标签页',
			name: newTabName,
			content: '新标签页内容'
		});
		editableTabsValue.value = newTabName;
	} else if (action === 'remove') {
		const tabs = editableTabs.value;
		let activeName = editableTabsValue.value;
		if (activeName === targetName) {
			tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
				if (tab.name === targetName) {
					const nextTab = tabs[index + 1] || tabs[index - 1];
					if (nextTab) {
						activeName = nextTab.name;
					}
				}
			});
		}
		editableTabsValue.value = activeName;
		editableTabs.value = tabs.filter((tab) => tab.name !== targetName);
	}
};
</script>

<style>
/* stylelint-disable selector-class-pattern -- Base-component BEM selectors are required for this demonstration. */

.demo-tabs > .el-tabs__content {
	padding: 32px;
	color: #6b778c;
	font-size: 32px;
	font-weight: 600;
}

/* stylelint-enable selector-class-pattern */
</style>
